axes: glTF Y-up, metres. Map ground y=0, sea surface y=-0.4 (SEA_Y).

border_pieces.footprint: normalised: max(X extent, Z extent) = 1.0 m, centred on origin; base y=0 with a 3 cm skirt below
border_pieces.scale: uniform scale in the engine (x8..x40 typical); rotate freely about Y

variants.dune_b: long transverse ridge (crest along Z, steep lee face +X)

border_pieces.materials: rock texture on steep faces + seasonal cover (grass/snow/dead ground) on flats; dunes: beach sand (+ snow in winter). Base colour = texture x COLOR_0.
border_pieces.notes_12I: 12I: no flat tops / straight skylines on mounds: shelves get a crowned, tilted multi-summit craggy top (were flat mesas) and are no longer clipped open at the grid edge (shelf_a/c had an open side 'cave'); gullies can no longer cut holes; dune_b crest is sinuous with uneven height. Peaks re-gridded (52x52) and shelves (84x84 over a wider area) -> all border pieces <=4.5k tris (were up to 6.46k). Footprint normalisation (above-ground X/Z extent = 1.0 m) unchanged. dune_a/c byte-identical.

coast_pieces.path: every coast piece starts at the origin heading +X; land on the LEFT (glTF -Z), sea on the RIGHT (glTF +Z) - same as shore_foam_strips_v2

chaining.outer (convex land corner, left turn, R=: ends at (6,0,-6), heading -Z (rotate the next piece +90 deg about Y)
chaining.inner (concave land corner, right turn,: ends at (6,0,+6), heading +Z (rotate the next piece -90 deg about Y)
chaining.straight6c: ends at (6,0,0), heading +X (third back-massing variant; interchangeable with straight6/6b of the same height)
chaining.seacliff_endcap_right_h{3,5,8}_{a,b}: RIGHT endcap closes the END of a run: place it exactly where the next piece would go (at the run's end point, same heading). Joint section at its origin = straight6 h end section (0.0 mm). The cap occupies one 6 m slot; its spire tip tapers to the ground at (6,0,0). Nothing chains after it.
chaining.seacliff_endcap_left_h{3,5,8}_{a,b}: LEFT endcap closes the START of a run: place it one slot before the first piece, i.e. its (6,0,0) end lands on the run's start point, same heading (tip at its origin). Joint section at (6,0,0) = straight6 h start section (0.0 mm). Nothing chains before it.
chaining.seacliff_step_h3h5 / h5h3 / h5h8 / h8h5: height step: start section = straight6 h{from} section, end section = straight6 h{to} section (both 0.0 mm). Ends at (6,0,0) heading +X; drop it in a straight slot between two runs of different height. For h3<->h8 chain two steps (h8h5 + h5h3 or h3h5 + h5h8).
chaining.rule_12I: no cliff run should ever end on a bare end wall: every free end gets an endcap of the matching height (left at the run start, right at the run end); every height change gets a step piece. Endcaps/steps only connect to straight sections of the same height at the joint (corners share the same end section, so they can also be joined directly to outer/inner).

coast_pieces.seams: all pieces of one family/height share an identical end cross-section (checked: 0 mm mismatch); surface noise fades to zero over the last 0.9 m 12I: endcap joint sections and both step ends verified identical to the straight6 end sections (0.0 mm) in all 4 seasons.
coast_pieces.seacliff: seacliff_{straight6,straight6b,outer,inner}_h{3,5,8}: lip (top edge) on the path line at y=h; sheer face down to a foot at y=-1.4, 1.4 m seaward; 1.2 m top then back slope reaching y=0 at 1.2+0.5h m inland. Ends are capped (hidden when chained; closes the end at height changes/free ends). straight6b = alternate face noise to break repetition. 12H: sea face battered ~70-73 deg; foot at y=-1.4 now 2.2/3.0/4.2 m seaward of the path at h3/h5/h8 (ends).
coast_pieces.beach: beach_{sand,shingle}_{straight6,outer,inner}: land edge on the path (tucked 0.4 m inland below ground), shelving to y=-0.8 at 4 m seaward; waterline ~2.8 m out; shingle has a storm berm ~1.2 m out. Winter: snow above the high-water line.
coast_pieces.endcaps: 12I: seacliff_endcap_{left,right}_h{3,5,8}_{a,b} x 4 seasons. 6 m long (u=3 texture continuity). From the joint the cliff rises into a jagged, faceted rock spire/shoulder (~1.4-1.6x h for h3, ~1.45x h8; set back 1-2 m behind the lip, broad land flank) and then tapers in a three-sided pyramid down to the ground on the land side and under the sea on the sea side; tip column <=0.12 m above y=0. a/b = different spire position, size, secondary horn and noise seeds. Half talus fan only on the joint side. Snow/grass by slope (winter snow on ledges).
coast_pieces.steps: 12I: seacliff_step_h3h5/h5h3/h5h8/h8h5 x 4 seasons. 6 m; section morphs smoothly between the two heights (rows of the lower profile duplicated to match the taller profile, so the low end has a few zero-length edges by design - validator INFO only), jagged shoulder spire on the high side, talus fan of each height at its own end.

notes_12F.what: seacliff land-side back rebuilt as mountain massing: stepped jagged skyline rising to ~1.2-1.35h, rock ribs and gullies, strata ledges (cover/snow on ledges per season), inland spurs mid-piece; border_peak/shelf get radial gullies, spurs and strata terraces
notes_12F.unchanged: sea face, lip and plateau rows (o<=0.8 m) vertex-identical to 12E; path, length, end_xz, corner radius, heading, node names; end sections identical across straight6/6b/6c/outer/inner of a height (0.0 mm); peaks/shelves still normalised to 1.0 m
notes_12F.footprint_change: ground contact at piece ends unchanged (1.2+0.5h inland); mid-piece the back spurs reach further inland (max inland: h3 ~5.0 m, h5 ~7.3 m, h8 ~10.3 m on straights/inner; outer corners capped so they never cross the R=6 turn centre)
notes_12F.anti_repetition: use straight6, straight6b and straight6c in rotation on long runs

notes_12G.what: seacliff land-side backs re-shaped as weathered massing: rounded eroded shoulder (~45 deg flank, concave toe), no quantised steps or flat-topped spurs, multi-lobe inland spurs with long ramps, gullies of varying width (1.8-3.2 m wavelength, not locked to the 6 m piece), scree/talus aprons fading into the ground, a half talus fan at each piece end so joints read as broad cols with scree instead of V-notches; skyline still ridged-noise jagged but lower (max ~1.13-1.15h). border_peak/shelf: strata terraces removed, rounded shoulders, uneven tops and aprons. Winter/other cover now follows slope (per-face normal + noise) instead of capping ledges.
notes_12G.unchanged: sea face, lip and plateau rows (o<=0.8 m) vertex-identical; end sections identical across straight6/6b/6c/outer/inner per height (0.0 mm); path, end_xz, headings, node names; peaks/shelves normalised to 1.0 m; islands, dunes, beaches untouched
notes_12G.footprint: max inland reach: h3 ~4.9 m, h5 ~7.5 m, h8 ~11.2 m (inner corner; straights <=10.4 m). Talus fans add ~0.36h beyond the 12E ground line within 2.4 m of each end; outer-corner end fans run straight along the end tangent (bbox x down to -2.1 m at h8).

notes_12H.what: seacliff sea face pitched (battered) instead of near-vertical: target 73/71/70 deg at h3/h5/h8 waterline->lip, pitch varies along the face (buttresses steeper/gentler, zero variation at the lip and piece ends), slight convex shoulder under the lip, wave-cut notch ~0.2 m deep at y~0.2, flared foot down to y=-1.4. Existing face rock detail (ridged flutes, bands, joints) and texture kept. Same row count -> tris unchanged.
notes_12H.unchanged: lip row on the path line and the plateau top; 12G land-side massing, talus fans, end caps topology; end sections identical across straight6/6b/6c/outer/inner per height (0.0 mm, new shared profile); path, end_xz, headings, node names; border_peak/shelf/dune, beaches, islands untouched (peak/shelf flanks were already sloped, <=3% of area steeper than 85 deg)

notes_12I.what: Peaked ends: the flat end walls of cliff runs are closed by endcap pieces with natural 3D rock spires that taper into ground and sea; height changes use step pieces with a shoulder spire; flat tops/edges removed from border mounds (shelves, dune_b).
notes_12I.new_files: 64 = 48 endcaps (left/right x h3/h5/h8 x a/b x 4 seasons) + 16 steps (4 x 4 seasons)
notes_12I.unchanged: all 12H seacliff straight/corner pieces and beaches are byte-identical to 12H (sea face pitch, 12G lumps, node names, headings, end sections). border_dune_a/c unchanged.
notes_12I.flat_faces: largest coplanar patch (3 deg tolerance, above ground): border peaks/shelves <=0.008 m2 (<=0.4% of area, unit footprint), dunes <=0.009 m2 (<=1.5%); cliff land side <=2.1 m2 only in the 0.9 m joint blend zone (must stay the canonical shared section). The only large planar faces left are the joint end curtains (x=0 / x=6 planes) of straights, corners, steps and the joint side of endcaps - always hidden by the neighbour when chained. Endcap tip ends have no end wall (tip column <=0.12 m high).
